# NEAR Builders

> NEAR Builders (nearbuilders.org) is an open network where people building on NEAR find each other, make their work visible, and find where to start building. Builders join with their NEAR account, share projects, and follow what others are shipping.

Start with the build page to pick a topic (Smart Contracts, Private Cloud, Agentic Commerce), then join. Point a coding agent at skill.md for step-by-step instructions.

## Start here

- [Build on NEAR](https://nearbuilders.org/build): topics, docs and tools for building on NEAR, including Agent Connect
- [Join NEAR Builders](https://nearbuilders.org/join): create a builder profile, with or without a nomination
- [skill.md](https://nearbuilders.org/skill.md): agent instructions for joining, building and getting involved

## Community

- [Builders](https://nearbuilders.org/builders): directory of approved builders
- [Projects](https://nearbuilders.org/projects): projects and ideas shared by builders
- [Events](https://nearbuilders.org/events): NEAR events and meetups
- [Activity](https://nearbuilders.org/activity): what builders are shipping, with a leaderboard

## Optional

- [About](https://nearbuilders.org/about): about the platform
- [API reference](https://nearbuilders.org/api): NEAR Builders API docs and OpenAPI spec
- [Run or fork NEAR Builders](https://github.com/NEARBuilders/nearbuilders.org#run-or-fork-near-builders): platform documentation
